description: This file defines the class `SugarFieldRadioenum`, a specialized form field class extending `SugarFieldBase`. It primarily provides functionality to retrieve display values for radio enumeration fields in email templates within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SugarFieldRadioenum
classes.description: A class extending `SugarFieldBase`, specifically handling radio enum fields, providing methods to retrieve display values in email templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Returns the display value corresponding to a stored input field value for radio enum options; defaults to returning the input if no display value is found.
